name: Registration and verification
summary: Open sign-up, email verification, and the first-login prompts that complete a profile and company details.

roles.note: Registration and verification run before sign-in, so no project or company role applies.

nfr.statement: Time from submitting sign-up to receiving the verification email.
nfr.open_question: What delivery time is acceptable, and is it measured (provider webhooks)?

requirements.title: Anyone can register
requirements.statement: Track3D is B2B, and registration is open to everyone. No invitation is needed to create an account.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A person with no Track3D account and no invitation
acceptance_criteria.when: They register with their work email and a password
acceptance_criteria.then: An account is created and a verification email is sent

requirements.title: Accounts never wait for approval
requirements.statement: Pending approval applies only to projects. A user account is usable once its email is verified, with no approval step.

sources.title: Product walkthrough and clarifications recorded in the 2026-10-28 ledger

acceptance_criteria.given: A newly registered user who has verified their email
acceptance_criteria.then: They are signed in without waiting for any account approval

requirements.title: Verifying email activates the account and applies pending invitations
requirements.statement: A verification link works only if it is correctly signed, unexpired and not already used or revoked. On success the account is marked verified, all its verification links are revoked, and any pending project invitations for that email are applied.
open_checks: Applying invitations and sending emails can fail after the account is already marked verified

acceptance_criteria.given: A user with a pending invitation to project P and an unused verification link
acceptance_criteria.then: Their account is verified, the link stops working, and they are a member of project P

acceptance_criteria.given: A verification link that has expired
acceptance_criteria.then: Verification fails with an expired result, and the account stays unverified

requirements.title: Sign-up asks only for email and password
requirements.statement: The sign-up form requires only an email and a password. Other details are collected after the first sign-in.

acceptance_criteria.then: Only email and password fields are shown

requirements.title: First sign-in completes the profile, including job title
requirements.statement: On first sign-in, users are prompted to complete their profile. Existing users without a job title must give one before continuing.

acceptance_criteria.given: A user signing in for the first time
acceptance_criteria.then: They are prompted to complete their profile

acceptance_criteria.given: An existing user with no job title
acceptance_criteria.then: A job-title prompt is shown, and they can't continue until they answer it

requirements.title: Company details on first sign-in
requirements.statement: A user from a new domain is asked for company type, company name and an optional mobile number. A user from a domain that already has a company sees that company's details filled in.

acceptance_criteria.given: The first user from a domain with no company
acceptance_criteria.then: They are asked for company type, company name and an optional mobile number

acceptance_criteria.given: A user from a domain that already has a company
acceptance_criteria.then: The company details are filled in for them
